orgName: Oling Dawn Kerjew Humanitarian and Charities
tagline: Service to humanity — for God and mankind.
description: Oling Dawn Kerjew Humanitarian and Charities (ODKHC) is a registered non-profit delivering sustainable education, healthcare, women's empowerment and community development to underprivileged populations across Uganda — with special focus on needy children, women and girls, and the families of Uganda's security personnel.
registeredAddress: Adebe Cell, Western Ward, Kamdini Town Council, Oyam South County, Oyam District, Northern Uganda
